task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A man in a dark jacket with green stripes and dark trousers is shown working on a large, light-colored woven basket in a rustic, dimly lit workshop. He bends over the basket, which sits on a dirt floor scattered with wood shavings and strips, using a tool to manipulate the weave. The camera cuts to a close-up of his hands, one wearing a black digital watch, as he tightly grips and adjusts a thick, dark wooden handle or stake integrated into the basket's rim. The scene returns to a wider shot where the man, now seated, lifts and rotates the finished-looking basket to inspect it, revealing its sturdy, rectangular shape and thick woven texture. A wooden bench and other tools are visible in the background.
